note: Planted Kavita FSD key; frozen when written; never read by a reviewer.

items.text: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
items.code: The Home On Deck row requests page 1 with 20 items, so it shows up to 20 series: UI/Web/src/app/dashboard/_components/dashboard.component.ts:194 (getOnDeck(1, 20)).

items.text: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
items.code: For libraries other than Book, Light Novel and Comic, the default tab is Storyline (Specials only when there are no volumes or chapters): UI/Web/src/app/series-detail/_components/series-detail/series-detail.component.ts:842-858 (this.activeTabId = Tabs.Storyline at :857).

items.text: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
items.code: Book reader font size is limited to 50%-300%: UI/Web/src/app/_services/epub-reader-settings.service.ts:79-80 (max(path.bookReaderFontSize, 300)).

items.text: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
items.code: Removal is a daily background task and only applies to series whose publication status is Completed or Cancelled and whose read progress is 100%: Kavita.Services/CleanupService.cs:331-370 (status filter at :345); scheduled with Cron.Daily at Kavita.Services/TaskScheduler.cs:229-231.

items.text: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
items.code: The reading list filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items: UI/Web/src/app/reading-list/_components/reading-list-detail/reading-list-detail.component.html:204 (items().length > 10).

items.text: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
items.code: The minimum password length is 6 characters: Kavita.Server/Extensions/IdentityServiceExtensions.cs:59 (opt.Password.RequiredLength = 6), enforced by Kavita.Services/AccountService.cs:58-60.

items.text: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
items.code: The confirmation threshold is 100 MB (104,857,600 bytes): UI/Web/src/app/shared/_services/download.service.ts:76 (SIZE_WARNING) and :1144-1149 (confirmSize).

items.text: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
items.code: The General page has no Save button; valid changes are saved automatically 300 ms after editing: UI/Web/src/app/admin/manage-settings/manage-settings.component.ts:112-133 (debounceTime(300), filter valid, updateServerSettings).

items.text: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
items.code: Manage Collections defaults to off for a new library: UI/Web/src/app/sidenav/_modals/library-settings-modal/library-settings-modal.component.ts:157 (manageCollections: false).

items.what: The Browse Genres screen (lists every genre with series and issue counts; clicking a genre opens All Series filtered to it) is left out entirely.
The All Annotations screen (browse and filter the user's and shared annotations across all books) is left out entirely.
The PDF reader screen, where PDF files open, is left out entirely (the Readers section only names the image and book readers).
On the General settings page, the Port and IP Addresses fields are fixed and cannot be edited when Kavita runs in Docker (UI/Web/src/app/admin/manage-settings/manage-settings.component.ts:86-88).
The library dialog's Exclude Patterns setting: glob patterns that the scanner matches and skips (library-settings-modal.component.html:266-269).

Bulk actions on the Libraries page: select several libraries and scan, refresh covers, generate ColorScape, delete, or copy one library's settings to the others (admin/manage-library/manage-library.component.ts:200-245).
The Remove Read button in reorder mode, which removes every already-read item from the list; shown only to the owner of a list that is not promoted (reading-list-detail.component.html:174-180).

The Page Offset switch in the image reader settings, which shifts how pages pair up in a double-page layout; it is disabled in single-page layout and webtoon mode (manga-reader.component.html:273-276, manga-reader.component.ts:338).
The Remove from On Deck action in the series actions menu, available to all users (action-factory.service.ts:640).
The Blur Unread Summaries preference, which blurs summaries of volumes or chapters with no read progress to avoid spoilers (manage-user-preferences.component.html).

matching.gap_or_conflict: found when a finding (state gap or conflict; the strict score also needs the planted kind) is on the item's section and its FSD quote overlaps the planted sentence: one contains the other, or at least 60% of the quote's words are in it.
matching.undocumented: found when a finding with state undocumented is on one of the item's pages, or on the item's section, and (for a behaviour) one of its keywords is in the finding's page quote or note, case-insensitive.
matching.falseAlarm: a finding (gap, conflict or undocumented) that matches no planted item is unplanted; the hand check of a sample of 20 (fixed seed) says which are real drift.
matching.ranges: 95% ranges by resampling planted items, 1,000 resamples, seed 42.
